experiment: Equal-budget MSE learning-rate schedules with exact shared optimizer-state reconstruction
scope: Exploratory research on the same repeatedly inspected141 validation Fridays in2018-2020. No new dates, assets, prices, features, losses, architecture, sample policy, trading simulation or live changes. No independent-confirmation claim.
objective: Original round6 standardized executable-return MSE +0.1*standardized auxiliary five-bar OHLCV MSE. Reproduce the original elementwise expressions and reduction order for exact reconstruction. No Huber loss and no auxiliary removal.
data: Byte-copy round11 training-only caches, causal indices and training scales. Training sizes1678,1921,2165, with joint label completion <= cutoff. Original batches128, final sizes14,1,117 and steps14,16,17 per epoch. Validation masks must exactly match rounds6/10,49+46+46=141 observations. Separate validation feature cache is never loaded by reconstruction or continuation programs.
reconstruction: Rebuild the nine original combined MSE20 states from initialization with the original seeds, full sample permutations and AdamW. Save model, full optimizer state, NumPy/CPU/CUDA random states. Require exact tensor equality with each archived round6 epoch20 state and identical target scales before any branches or new validation predictions. On mismatch stop and diagnose; do not silently substitute a different starting state.
controlled_continuation: Each of the two schedules restores the same serialized epoch20 model, optimizer moments and step counts, CPU/CUDA random states and NumPy permutation stream. Epoch21 does not reset the optimizer or random stream. The only configured difference is the learning rate for epochs21-40. Continue the original stream to epoch40. No intermediate validation forecasts or early stopping.
weight_decay_interpretation: Nominal AdamW weight_decay stays0.1. Its decoupled per-update multiplier includes learning rate, so changing learning rate also changes nominal shrinkage. This is the effect of the full learning-rate schedule within fixed AdamW settings, not an isolated gradient-step effect. Record nominal cumulative decay factors, conditional on a parameter receiving a gradient each step.
budget: Nine shared20-epoch reconstructions plus18 twenty-epoch continuations, equivalent to18 complete40-epoch paths with the identical prefix shared for efficiency. Actual540 training epochs. Save9 complete prefix checkpoints and18 complete final checkpoints. Reuse nine archived MSE20 checkpoints/predictions. One GPU training worker. No outcome-dependent fits, schedule/epoch search or best-seed choice.

training_diagnostics.states: Nine reconstructed epoch20 states and eighteen final epoch40 states
training_diagnostics.metrics: Fixed-state training return MSE, auxiliary MSE and their0.1-weighted joint objective, dropout off and eight fixed paired dropout draws. Audits preserve RNG/modes/weights. Report all fixed monitor epochs and clipping diagnostics. Finite-draw means are not exact expectations or statistical confirmation.

validation: Only after all training and reconstruction checks finish, compute the predetermined epoch40 predictions for both schedules. Reuse the archived epoch20 predictions. Evaluate all fixed seeds and their equal-weight three-seed ensembles on exactly141 weeks. Primary metric is raw executable-return MSE; report direction accuracy, RMSE, MAE, forecast SD, within-fold SD and cyclic within-fold input reassignment as diagnostics. Causal full-training mean and zero-return forecasts are constant references.
inference: Four prespecified paired ensemble weekly MSE comparisons. Circular8-observation blocks,10000 bootstrap replicates,seed20260910,centered two-sided p; Holm across all four. Percentile95% intervals are descriptive and need not invert the centered test. Seed/fold counts are descriptive, not independent-sample tests. Historical reuse remains exploratory even with multiplicity correction.
